title: VolumePad
description: A haptic volume knob with an LED ring, built end to end: custom PCB, firmware, Windows companion app and a Stream Deck plugin.

title: FluxNode
description: A compact BLDC motor controller for field-oriented control: STM32G4, three-phase power stage, current sensing & CAN-FD. Making motors spin smoothly, one Clarke/Park transform at a time.

title: time-2-love
description: A small WiFi-connected countdown device built with an ESP8266 and an OLED display, plus a React Native companion app.

title: digit-classifier
description: Draw a digit, let the neural network guess. A little tkinter app for playing with handwritten digit and letter recognition.
